title: Crosslinking MS: from peptide pairs to structural restraints
zh_title: 交联质谱：从肽段对到结构约束
summary: Trace crosslink chemistry, paired-peptide evidence, error-control levels, and the limits of structural interpretation.
zh_summary: 追踪交联化学、肽段对证据、错误控制层级以及结构解释的边界。

title: Glycoproteomics: evidence and ambiguity
zh_title: 糖蛋白质组学：证据与歧义
summary: Separate peptide identity, glycan composition, attachment sites, and structural detail before interpreting glycopeptide signals.
zh_summary: 解释糖肽信号前，区分肽段身份、糖链组成、连接位点与结构细节。

title: Phosphoproteomics: enrichment, localization and quantification
zh_title: 磷酸化蛋白质组学：富集、定位与定量
summary: Plan phosphopeptide enrichment, preserve site ambiguity, and distinguish signal changes from protein-adjusted and occupancy measurements.
zh_summary: 规划磷酸肽富集、保留位点歧义，并区分信号变化、蛋白质校正测量与占有率测量。
